operations.description:
Returns the configuration of a specific server.
Required permission: 'servers' or 'createserver'

operations.summary: Get specific account. Required permission 'sessions' or 'accounts'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] servers accounts [PARAMS] accountid server [SCHEMA] account

operations.description:
Based on the browser/webserver session identifier, check if the user is logged in and return the associated username. The n-Auth server can handle multiple realms in which a user can separately be registrated. This also returns additional information: the data for a login visual (qr/nauth) code and whether or not a loggin can be provoked directly from the server. 
Required permission: 'sessions'
operations.summary: Check if the user is logged in
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] servers sessions [PARAMS] nonce realm server [SCHEMA] login status

operations.description:
Returns the data for a n-auth or qr code.
Required permission: 'sessions'
operations.summary: Generate data for a qr code
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] servers sessions qr [PARAMS] img name nonce realm server type userid [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Returns an array of arrays containing all accounts corresponding to all users
Required permission: 'users'

Returns an array containing all accounts corresponding to this user
Required permission: 'sessions' or 'users'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] servers users [PARAMS] realm server userid [SCHEMA] account

operations.description: Returns a PNG of the visual hash corresponding to this server. Required permission 'sessions' or 'servers'
Hook for the n-Auth protocol handler
Create a new server. Required permission 'createserver'
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] servers [PARAMS] enabled owner pin servername [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Provoke a login in the n-Auth app on the given session. Required permission 'sessions' or 'accounts'
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] servers accounts provokelogin [PARAMS] accountid nonce server [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Force a logout on the given session

Required permission: 'sessions'
operations.summary: Force a logout on the given session
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] servers sessions logout [PARAMS] nonce server [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Provoke a login in the n-Auth app on the given session. Required permission: 'sessions'
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] servers sessions provokelogin [PARAMS] nonce server [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Register a user (under a certain realm) for the currently logged in user. You can also directly pass a userid when generating an ENROL qr code. Required permission 'users'
operations.summary: Register a userid for the given realm.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] servers sessions registeruser [PARAMS] nonce realm server userid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Provoke a login in the n-Auth app on the given session. Required permission 'users' or 'sessions'
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] servers users provokelogin [PARAMS] nonce realm server userid [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Update the configuration of a specific server.
Required permission: 'createserver'
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] servers [PARAMS] flags name pin ping server time timeout trans [SCHEMA] config

operations.description: Update an account. The only available change is (un)blocking the account. Required permission 'accounts'
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] servers accounts [PARAMS] accountid blocked server [SCHEMA] account
